name: Rainbow Slider
author: rainbowslider

sections.description:
⭐Rainbow Slider is a Good Slider for Your WordPress Website use Any Theme :
Rainbow Slider is a lightweight and reliable slider plugin that works smoothly with Elementor on any WordPress theme. It doesn’t matter if your website has a theme or not, it will work as long as it is beautiful.
If your website doesn’t have elements. Then it will work very well. That is, it will work on any theme. It allows you to create beautiful, responsive sliders using Elementor sections and containers without affecting your existing design. The plugin supports modern layouts including flexbox and grid, while offering features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls to ensure a fast and engaging slider experience on all devices.

👉Rainbow Slider is Carousel :
Rainbow Slider is a lightweight carousel slider plugin built for Elementor. It lets you transform Elementor sections and containers into smooth, responsive carousel sliders without altering your original designs. The plugin supports Elementor sections, flexbox containers, and grid layouts while preserving full design integrity. With features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable carousel experience for Elementor-powered websites.

👉Rainbow Slider is Elementor Slider :
Rainbow Slider is a lightweight and flexible slider plugin designed exclusively for Elementor. It allows you to convert Elementor sections and containers into smooth, responsive sliders without modifying your original designs. The plugin fully supports Elementor sections, flexbox containers, and grid layouts while preserving complete design integrity. With features such as autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable slider experience for Elementor-powered websites.

👉Rainbow Slider is Swiper Slider :
Rainbow Slider is a lightweight Swiper-based slider plugin built for Elementor. It allows you to transform Elementor sections and containers into smooth, responsive Swiper sliders without changing your original designs. The plugin supports Elementor sections, flexbox containers, and grid layouts while keeping full design integrity. With features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable Swiper slider experience for Elementor-powered websites.

The plugin supports modern layouts including flexbox and grid while maintaining full design integrity. With features such as autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable image slider experience for any Elementor-powered website.

👉Rainbow Slider is Image Carousel :

The plugin supports Elementor sections, flexbox containers, and grid layouts while preserving full design integrity. With features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable image carousel experience for Elementor-powered websites.

Rainbow Slider is a lightweight gallery slider plugin built for Elementor. It enables you to convert Elementor sections and containers into smooth, responsive gallery sliders without changing your original designs. The plugin supports Elementor sections, flexbox containers, and grid layouts while preserving full design integrity. With features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable gallery slider experience for Elementor-powered websites.

👉Rainbow Slider is Video Slider :
Rainbow Slider is a lightweight and flexible video slider plugin built for Elementor. It allows you to create smooth, responsive video sliders using Elementor sections and containers without affecting your original designs. The plugin supports YouTube, Vimeo, and external video sources, as well as self-hosted videos, while maintaining full design integrity. With features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination, and touch-friendly controls, Rainbow Slider delivers a fast, modern, and reliable video slider experience for Elementor-powered websites.

✅Rainbow Slider is a lightweight, flexible, and powerful slider plugin built specifically for Elementor. It allows you to create beautiful and responsive sliders using Elementor sections and containers, regardless of the WordPress theme you use. The plugin supports carousel sliders, image sliders, gallery sliders, slideshows, text sliders, and icon sliders while preserving your original design. With full support for flexbox and grid layouts, along with features like autoplay, infinite loop, navigation, pagination, smooth animations, and responsive controls, Rainbow Slider helps you build modern, visually rich, and professional slider sections that enhance your website’s appearance and user experience.

Now with Elementor Container (Flexbox & Grid) Support!

Key Features:

  • Drag & Drop Design: Use Elementor to design each slide.
  • Universal Support: Works with old Sections, new Flexbox Containers, and Grid Containers.
  • Auto Height: Automatically adjusts height based on slide content.
  • Live Preview: Works perfectly inside the Elementor Editor.
  • Zero Bloat: Only loads scripts where the shortcode is used.
  • Touch Friendly: Fully responsive and mobile-optimized.

How it works:

  1. Go to Rainbow Slider > Add New.
  2. Design your slides using Elementor (Each Section/Container becomes a slide).
  3. Copy the shortcode (e.g., [rainbow_slider id='123']).
  4. Paste it anywhere on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rainbow-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Rainbow Slider menu to create your first slider.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Elementor Free?

Yes, it works perfectly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro versions.

Can I use Elementor Flexbox Containers?

Yes! Starting from version 3.0.0, this plugin fully supports Elementor Sections, Flexbox Containers, and Grid Containers.

How do I create slides?

Simply create a new Rainbow Slider post. Inside Elementor, every main Section or Container (Parent) you add will act as a single slide.

Why is the slider not showing in the editor?

Ensure you are using the latest version of the plugin. We have added a live preview feature that works inside the Elementor editor when you use the shortcode widget.

Is it responsive?

Yes, since it uses Swiper.js and Elementor’s native responsiveness, your slider will look great on Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop.
